<dl class="command_description">

<dd class="note">
The indexes of the returned array's elements are relative to the pylon indexes, such that element 0 is pylon 1, element 1 is pylon 2, etc.

{{Note
|user= Sa-Matra
|timestamp= 20240504051358
|text= Just like [[getAllPylonsInfo]] this command returns last pylon state which can include non-existent magazine that was deleted with [[removeMagazineTurret]]
}}
